fields.description: Issue includes local commentary and humor columns (including recurring "Little Geraldine" items), extensive coverage of entertainment and nightlife in Miami Beach (clubs, theaters, dancing, visiting performers), and sports-related content and promotions (horse racing at Hialeah, greyhound racing, jai alai, golf). It also features an editorial-style piece criticizing gambling interests and urging enforcement of laws, with references to prohibition and civic institutions, alongside numerous advertisements for local businesses, travel, and events in the Miami area.
